{{Otheruses|Seeker}}
'''Advanced seeker missiles''' were a variant of the [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] that possessed homing capabilities. They were similar to [[homing concussion missile]]s, and were equippable on [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)}}
While attempting to [[Rescue on Kessel|rescue]] both fellow member [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and several other Rebel POWs, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], after making sure any threats to the escape shuttle were eliminated, destroyed a bunker near the second prison facility and retrieved the advanced seeker missiles.
{{Endgame}}
